item.title: [CRITICAL] CISA KEV Alert: CVE-2026-102895 in GPUStack GPUStack Under Active Exploitation
item.description: GPUStack GPUStack is affected by CVE-2026-102895. GPUStack contains an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow unauthenticated administrative access, including user and model changes, persistent administrator API-key creation, disclosure of worker and cloud-provider secrets, and code execution through POST /v2/inference-backends/fro... Action: Mandatory remediation: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines. Check retail perimeter and server inventory for GPUStack.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Installing the Fix for an Exploited WordPress Flaw Can Expose Some Sites One Last Time
item.description: Some WordPress sites can still be attacked while they install the fix for an actively exploited flaw, according to Umut Bayram, the Picus Security researcher who found it. The update that installs the fix still unpacks its files using the site's old, unpatched code, so an attacker who strikes at the right moment can run code on the server. The rese... Action: Urgent: Patch edge devices and review perimeter telemetry immediately.
